author: (Say, 1825)

note.en: A soft, slimy-skinned brittle star that hides in crevices; known here from a few museum records. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura de piel blanda y mucosa que se esconde en grietas; conocida aquí por pocos registros de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 4 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range
